entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: Passenger EV sales rise from 2 million in 2018 to 10 million in 2025, 28 million in 2030 and 56 million by 2040.

entries.metric: EV share of new passenger vehicle sales, global
entries.quote: By 2040 we expect 57% of all passenger vehicles sales and just over 30% of the global passenger vehicle fleet will be electric.

entries.subject: electric vehicle price parity
entries.metric: year EVs reach price parity with ICE vehicles in most segments
entries.quote: we expect price parity between EVs and internal combustion vehicles by the mid-2020s in most segments, though the first segment crosses by 2022
entries.note: Band 'mid-2020s'; target_year 2025 is the band centre. First segment by 2022.

notes: Public executive summary of EVO 2019 (BNEF's own document, hosted by E&E News). The summary calls it BNEF's 'fourth annual' EVO, which counts 2016 as the first. Scope changed from 'light-duty vehicles' (2016-2018) to 'passenger vehicles' from 2019: a label change (Revision), not noise.
